calls.video_title: I Just Invested €1,000 in THESE 4 Stocks! (October 2026)
calls.price_at_call: ~$158 (stated); buy limit $130 for a larger entry (stated)
calls.thesis: Opening an initial position (2 shares, just under €300): price back to Sep 2024 levels after AI-anxiety pullback from $230, while operations still run well with strong margins, ROE and buyback-funded FCF.
calls.base_case: Normal: growth continues with buybacks, current P/E ~17-18 justified -> fair value ~30% above current price, ~10%/yr expected return.
calls.bull_case: Positive: more than double if the business cannot easily be replaced by AI agents.
calls.bear_case: Negative: AI agents take share, growth stalls then -2%/yr from year 6 -> fair P/E 10, fair price only $40.

calls.thesis: Stock -30% on AI-agent booking disruption fears (Meta's 'News' agent + Expedia partnership), but business still superb: ~25% net margins, P/FCF ~14, 5%/yr buybacks; his weighted 3-scenario model rates it HOLD, not buy, at $162.
